notice: Coordinates for the ports named in the synthetic shipment fixtures, used only to ask hazard and weather providers about a point. Verified entries cite the page read on checked_on. UN/LOCODE coordinates are published to the arc-minute (about 1.8 km), so these points are port-area locations, not berth positions. The official UNECE country pages (service.unece.org/trade/locode/<cc>.htm) refused automated reading on 2026-10-10, so UN/LOCODE values were read from the datasets/un-locode mirror of the UNECE 2025-1 release. Unverified entries keep hand-entered coordinates and say why. A code not listed here is unsupported: no coordinates are guessed.

locations.name: Shanghai
